text: I was chosen to guard these chickens.
zh: 我被选中来看守这些鸡。

text: This is a rather important task, as these little fellas provide some of our food.
zh: 这可是个相当重要的任务，这些小家伙可是我们的口粮来源之一。

text:
So, stay away from them!
I'm not taking any chances!
zh:
所以，离它们远点！
我可不想冒任何风险！

text: Stay away from the chickens, please.
